# Pleophylla warnockae

Pleophylla warnockae is a species of beetle of the family Scarabaeidae. It is found in South Africa (Limpopo).
Description
Adults reach a length of about 8.1–10 mm. The pronotum is unicoloured and has dense and thick erect setae. The elytra have dark spots and dense, erect dorsal pilosity.
Etymology
The species is named after Rachel Warnock.
